content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was that on some Panasonic laptop models, the volume up, down, and mute keypresses were being reported twice—once through the Panasonic ACPI HKEY interface and again through the atkbd (keyboard) device. This duplication led to unintended behavior, as the same keypress events were processed multiple times. The patch addresses this issue by filtering out the duplicate keypress events from the atkbd device in the kernel, ensuring that only one instance of each keypress is reported.
